balls.text: a wide full toss. Wadhera throws his bat at it but ends up slicing it somewhat. Bishnoi at deep extra cover takes it comfortably
a wide yorker this time. Wadhera looks to repeat the shot but cannot connect and the ball goes between his legs
Four more. Full outside off. Moves across and sweeps it to the right of short fine leg
length ball around off, angling towards the batter and Wadhera just pulls it over deep square leg. Into the stands
short of length outside off. Wadhera looks to ramp it up but fails to connect
offcutter. Full outside off. Wadhera moves across and scoops it over short fine leg for four
An excellent over from Mohsin. A length ball angling across. Shokeen moves across and looks to slap it behind square leg but he is nowhere near the ball
length ball, well outside off. Jordan drags it from there and looks to clear long-on. But Mohsin had rolled his fingers over it and Jordan can only find Hooda at the boundary line
length outside off. Jordan finally manages some bat on the ball. Hits it over covers for a couple
fast and full outside off. Jordan looks to hit it through the off side but once again finds thin air
length ball angling across. Goes for the cut but misses again

was a length ball angling across Jordan who had moved across to swing across. He fails to connect but Pooran 
too fails to collect, allowing four byes
slower length ball outside off. Opens the face of the bat to steer it towards short third

full outside off. Wadhera slices it to the right of deep extra cover. Wadhera was keen for the second and was halfway down the pitch but Jordan sends him back. The throw was at the wrong end, and wayward too. Pooran collects it and throws it to Naveen but all that allowed Wadhera to retrace his steps. The ball, though, hit Naveen on the shin and he is down
length ball angling towards the stumps. Tucked away towards square leg
105.3kph. Slower ball. Length outside off, and Varma flat-bats it towards long-off, just to the left of Hooda. Hooda charges in and slides to complete the catch
pace-on but angling further away from Varma. He tries to reach out for it but cannot. Wide again

slower again. Full and well outside off. Varma leaves it alone expecting it to be called a wide and is aghast when it's not. And after pondering for a bit he sends it upstairs. And yes, it was just outside the guide line - so a wide
too wide outside off this time
full and even wider outside off. Wadhera moves across and drags it towards midwicket
length ball, a slower one angling acorss and Wadhera just pulls it over deep square leg. Gowtham leaps and gets a hand on it but cannot lob it back
a slower length ball outside off. Cuts it towards deep point
a bouncer to this time. Wadhera fails to connect the pull but he has reviewed it for height. And this was just below the head height. So no wide

full and down the leg side. Brushes the pad as Wadhera looks to flick it away. Pooran hits the stumps direct as Wadhera was looking to sneak in a leg-bye. Was back in his crease before the ball hit the stumps, though

a high full toss outside off. David goes for the slog but ends up hitting it to long-on where Hooda pouches it. But the umpires want to send it upstairs to check the height. Touch-and-go, and the TV umpire thinks it would have been just below the waist height if the batter wasn't crouching. David isn't happy, though
length ball but once again outside off. David had moved towards the off side but it's still wide of him. Left alone
full and wide outside off and David throws his bat at it. Smashes it to the right of cover-point for four. Krunal leaps but fails to get a hand on it
length ball  but well outside off. Left alone to collect a wide. Thakur slips in his follow-through and seems to have hurt his ankle
short of length outside off. Looks to hit across but misses. Gets another leg-bye
another slower ball. Varma goes for the slog sweep/pull but fails to connect and gets hit on the body. An appeal for lbw but think the impact was outside off. They collect a leg-bye
a slower bounce now. Varma wasn't expecting it. Aborts his pull and watches it bounce in front of the keeper
length outside off. A slower one at 107.4kph. Tilak comes forward and steers it between point and short third
length ball around off. Comes forward and pushes it towards the bowler
length ball on the stumps. Tilak gets down on one knee and pull-sweeps it over deep-backward square leg for a six
short of length outside off, coming in with the angle. Pulled towards deep square leg
full outside off. Digs it out towards long-off
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards extra cover
full outside off. Almost in the slot but David mistimes it towards long-on and lets out a groan
length ball around off. Goes back and cuts it towards short third
length but sliding down the leg side. Called a wide
length ball on the stumps. Goes back and punches it to the left of short midwicket where Krunal makes a diving stop
length ball angling across. Cuts it towards deep point
114.3kph. Full around off. Varma mistimes the slog towards long-on
short of length. Goes for the pull but is late on the shot. Ends up dragging it towards short fine leg. Could have been off the glove as well
goes for the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss. 140.6kph. Tilak slices it towards deep point
length ball around off, slower again. Pushed towards covers
slower one. Full around off. Worked towards deep midwicket
A bouncer. Just outside off. Tilak gives himself room and looks to ramp it over but fails to connect
full on the pads. Pushed towards deep midwicket, the bigger side of the ground. The batters were looking for two but had to settle for one eventually
Tilak tries the reverse sweep to the ball pitching outside leg. Fails to connect, though. The ball hits his body and lobs towards short fine leg
length ball around off. Punched towards long-off
length ball on the pads. Clipped towards deep square leg. Tilak wanted the second but David says no
full on the stumps. David digs it out towards long-on
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards deep midwicket off the back foot
length ball around off. Pushed towards cover for one
full around off and Tilak brings out the slog sweep. Sends it into the stands over deep midwicket
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards long-on
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards deep midwicket
length ball outside off. Looks to push at it with hard hands. The ball hits the outer half of the bat and rolls towards short third
full on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on

What an over by Naveen! After getting Surya out with a legcutter, he has now bowled Green with an offcutter, bowled at 104.9kph. Was a length ball outside off that came back in to beat the push and knock down the off stump
length ball angling in. Varma closes the bat-face to turn it towards short midwicket. The bowler runs after the ball but cannot stop the single

The slower one does the trick. A legcutter bowled at 107.3kph, on the fuller side of good length. Surya looks to hit down the ground but the lack of pace means he ends up playing a touch early and chipping it instead of hitting it. Gowtham from long-off runs to his left to gobble it up
length ball outside off, coming in with the angle and moving away late to beat the outside edge. Surya was looking to push it through covers
short outside off, was a slower one at 103.5. Surya waits for it before steering it behind point. Bishnoi runs to his left this time and keeps it to two
short of length outside off. Surya punches it off the back foot and to the right of sweeper cover. Bishnoi puts in the chase, and the dive, and gets a hand to it, but fails to stop it

full outside off. Another cut chopped into the ground, towards short third this time. Surya wants a single. Green responds and just makes his ground, beating substitute Daniel Sams underarm throw to the keeper
short of length outside off. Cuts it into the ground towards covers
length ball on the pads - a googly. Helped towards deep midwicket
full on the stumps. Punched back. Bishnoi dives to his left but fails to stop it. The ball hits his hand and goes over his body
tossed up outside off. Too full. Surya digs it out towards sweeper cover
full on the stumps. Gives himself some room and uses his wrists to hit it aerially, to the left of extra cover for four
length ball around off. Green was on the front foot and still manages to pull over square leg. That's the shorter side but it went into the stands
length ball around off. Defended back
length ball around off. Punches it towards covers for one. Didn't middle it, though
short of length around off. Hops and dabs it down towards backward point
short of length angling towards the batter. Surya does a repeat of his six against Thakur and pulls it between keeper and fine leg for another six
length ball around off, 135kph. Green stays leg side of the ball and steers it towards long-off. Just shows how well the ball is coming onto the bat
slightly fuller outside off. Pushed towards deep extra cover off the front foot
95.6kph. Length outside off. Green was looking to flat-bat it through covers but aborts the shot seeing extra bounce
full outside off. Surya goes inside-out aerially but fails to middle it. The ball falls well short of wide long-off
short of length outside off. Cuts it towards backward point
a length ball on the stumps. Surya goes for the sweep but gets a top edge that just clears short fine leg
starts with a googly at the stumps. Backs away and punches it towards long-off
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep point
short outside off. Dabbed towards covers
short of length angling across. 135.3kph. Green goes for the pull but the ball sneaks underneath the bat
slightly shorter. A touch wider. Green flat-bats it through extra cover but the mid-off had moved to long-off after the last ball. So only two this time
length ball just outside off. Green drives it on the up and bisects the gap between extra cover and mid-off
starts with a length ball on the pads. Tucked away towards deep square leg
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket for an easy single
length ball angling towards the pads. Green moves further away and pushes it towards long-on
runs are coming thick and easy. Length ball on the stumps but Green backs away to create room and cut it to the right of the diving cover fielder for another boundary
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it to  the left of the point fielder for four
length outside off. Cuts it towards short third where the fielder lets the ball through his hands. Two more to Green
full on middle and leg. Green clears his front leg and launches it over wide long-on for a four
a six into the sightscreen but behind the keeper! Short at the batter. SKY slightly moves towards the off side and helps it over the keeper's head. All the way for a six
length ball outside off. Punched towards mid-off
length ball around off. Defended back
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards deep midwicket for a couple

Thakur strikes with his second ball.M Banged in short, and angling across the left-hander. Kishan looks to cut it over backward point but manages only an edge to Pooran. Both openers are back in the hut
length ball on the stumps, defended
short of length at the stumps. Green backs away to crease room but cannot free his arms as the ball follows him. Steered towards backward
more luck for Mumbai. A length ball in the channel that just holds its line. Green pushes at it and gets an outside edge that goes between the keeper and short third

length outside off. Much closer to the stumps as well this time. Green was looking to drop and run but ends up playing it with hard hands. The backward point is quick to the ball and prevents the single
short of length outside off. Was bowled wide of the crease and there was enough room for Green to free arms. Cuts it behind point to get off the mark

136.5kph. A length ball bowled from wide of the crease, Rohit jumps out of his crease and looks to go over extra cover but fails to middle it and ends up hitting it straight to Badoni. Naveen does shut-out-the-noise celebration
length ball on the stumps, pushes it towards mid-on and picks up a single
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards deep square leg
length ball on the pads. Swept towards short fine leg for one

Everything going Mumbai's way. Rohit backs away and Krunal follows him with a length ball. Rohit pushes at it but gets beaten on the inside edge. But Pooran too fails to collect and it goes for four byes
swept away. Length ball on the stumps, and Rohit sweeps it behind square leg. That's the shorter side as well
length ball around off. Defended on the front foot
Rohit goes big now. Full on the stumps, Rohit clears his front leg and slogs it over long-on. The first six of the night
this one is deliberate. Short of length outside off and Ishan cuts it between backward point and short third this time
length outside off. Pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge that beats the diving short third on his right
length ball on the stumps. Comes forward and looks to defend. The ball hits the inner half and rolls towards short midwicket
length outside off, goes for the cut and gets beaten
length outside off. Opens the face of the bat to work it towards point
full around off. Defended back
length ball outside off. Comes forward and pushes it to the bowler's left
length ball around off. Lunges forward and blocks
length ball around middle. Comes forward and defends again. Not from the middle of the bat, though
length ball on the stumps. Defended on the front foot
full around off. Kishan hits it uppishly to the right of the bowler. Krunal stretches his hand out but gets only fingertips to it
short of length outside off, Kishan goes back and cuts it away for four. Off the mark with a boundary

five for Madhwal! He ends with 5 for 5. LSG eliminated in the Eliminator for the second time in a row. MI into Qualifier 2. A yorker fired right on the base of off stump. That was too much for the No. 11 Mohsin, who tried to push at it, but failed. The ball ended up shaking the stumps, and gave Madhwal his fifth
length ball on middle and off. Nudged off the inside edge to midwicket
backs away and skips down, as the ball is on a good length on leg. It angles in, and is pushed back

short and wide of off. He tries to slash but misses, and it's given wide. And to add to some drama, Rohit reviews. Replays show the ball is indeed within the permissible limits out off, and the call is overturned
full and outside off, as it hints to angle away. He heaves and misses
backs away, and nudges back at this length ball angling into leg
now bowls a yorker length just outside off. Mohsin tries to loft but is beaten
shortish outside off, as he flashes but misses. There is good bounce again there
good length ball angling across and finishing wide-ish of off. He slashes but misses
full on the stumps, and drilled to extra cover after making room

third run-out of the innings! And Green and Rohit are involved again. LSG's hurt going deeper and deeper. They both ran to the striker's end, and ended up providing MI another wicket. Now this is what happened: Naveen guided this good length ball outside off with an open face of the bat, as Green - at backward point - dived to his left to stop that. He threw at the keeper's end, by which time both batters were there. Madhwal, who had reached there by then, threw to Rohit at the bowler's end
appeal for leg before, but not given. That would have slid down the leg side. Good length ball angling in, as Naveen tried to push from middle and off

fourth wicket for Madhwal! Bishnoi swipes one right to the long-on fielder. Madhwal bowled on a good length around fifth stump. Bishnoi, for all his might, looked to hoicked across the line. But the ball seemed to have skidded through, and was a bit too quick for his liking. In the end, a comfortable catch for the fielder
full around middle, and flicked to deep square
full ball angling into leg. Takes his pad as he tries to flick. The ball trickles away towards short fine
good length on middle. Tapped towards extra cover
short ball on middle, and pulled to deep backward square
makes room, and the bowler follows. Good length outside leg, and clipped to deep backward square leg
length ball on middle, shaping away towards off. Tapped to cover, as he sets off. Rohit threatens to throw, as Bishnoi rushes back
change of pace again. Low, dipping full toss on off. Pushed to long-on
slower ball. Full on middle and off, and angling across. Hooda pushes but is beaten
extra bounce off a shortish length outside off. Half-swished towards midwicket, surprised by the bounce
short outside off, and swatted to cover
lap swept behind the wicket

direct hit at the keeper's end! Rohit does the job for his side. His fielding keeps Mumbai in front. Remember the diving stop off Badoni, which might have forced the batter to attack and get dismissed? Rohit was at cover this time, and his threw hit the off stump to find a diving Gowtham short. The ball was cut away to point, where Green dived forward to stop. The moment he saw Gowtham attempt a run, he drilled the ball to Rohit
full on middle, and chipped down to long-off
short outside off, and turns away while keeping low. Slashed to deep point
good length ball angling into middle. Guided to point late

Stoinis is run-out! This could be the game. The two batters had collided in the middle of the pitch after both were busy watching the ball. They went for a second run there, and bumped into each other, before Stoinis tried to make his way back to the striker's end. The throw from long-on was there to the keeper by then, and the stumps were whipped. It was a full ball on off - change of pace too - as Green chipped it down

short ball, and extra bounce. Bangs it in on off stump, as the ball angles in late to end on top of leg stump. Stoinis sways down and tries to ramp, but is beaten. Green appealed for caught behind, but wasn't given
good length on off. Tucked towards long-on, as Green is sent back for an attempted second
short ball angling into leg. Pulled to fine leg off his glove
good length and wide of off. He throws his bat to half-swat to mid-off
this goes on straight off a good length, as Hooda gets an inside edge while pushing at it
turns into his pads off a good length. Clipped to deep square leg
full and hinting to turn into middle. Driven to long-off
full outside off. Turns in, as he gets across off. Slog swept to fine leg
very full and just outside off. Pushed to long-on
full and angling down, as it pitches outside leg. Wide given as he misses his flick
six over long-on! Full and wide of off from Chawla, but Hooda brings out the slog sweep to go down the pitch. Good shot
full ball on off, and driven to long-on

tickled to the keeper! Pooran goes back for a golden duck. Pooran. The man who has carried LSG so far. No run. LSG in trouble. Madhwal on a hat-trick. This time it is the seam movement that gets him a wicket. Madhwal is on top. He bowled on a length from around the wicket, angling it into the left-hander. The ball landed on the seam, and moved away just enough to entice Pooran to have a poke. He obliged, and ended up edging it

the off stump is gone! Three dots in a row forces Badoni to swipe across the line, and he is beaten again. Good length ball on off stump, which is angled into the batter. But the ball looked like going straight on after pitching, as Badoni pulled and missed. LSG losing their way in the middle overs
now Badoni is beaten! Extra bounce off a good length just outside off, as he stabs and misses
Rohit saves four runs! Dives to his right at cover, and throws himself at the ball. Length delivery on off, and driven hard by Badoni

animated appeal for leg before by Madhwal, but not given. He is trying to hard to convince Rohit for a review... and Rohit agrees late. Shorter side of a length on off, going on straight after pitching. Looked like the ball would go over the stumps on naked eye, but let's see. There's no bat involved as he looks to pull, and guess what... replays show umpire's call on hitting off stump

sharply-turning googly, and it's gone for leg byes behind the wicket. Stoinis was completely foxed by the turn. On a length on off, as it turned in while also bouncing nicely. Stoinis' bat was pushing from off stump, with a gap between bat and pad. The ball turned in and went through the gap, and over the stumps
full and quicker on off. Defended off the inside edge towards midwicket
slow turn away from a good length on off. Poked to point with the turn
full and flat on off. Blocked back

jumps out of the crease... but finds the long-on fielder! That went quite high, but didn't have timing. The time-out breaks LSG's momentum. It was a full delivery from Chawla, enticing the batter to go for the big hit. That's what Pandya did by stepping out early, only to end up lofting it right to the fielder
low full toss on off, and drilled to long-on
length ball shaping into off from outside off. Punched back, as Green hits the stumps at the striker's end with an underarm throw
length ball, and wide of off. Driven well, but right to the extra-cover fielder
good length ball heading into his pads. Clipped to deep square leg
good length ball on fourth stump. He pokes at it very late after getting a bit across, and bags a single to deep third
pulls his length back to go on a good length on off. Angles into middle, and is tapped to point
yorker length ball on sixth stump. He tries to heave but is beaten
turns away to end outside off after pitching short on off. Punched towards midwicket, where Rohit dives to his right to save a few
slog swept to fine leg! Full ball outside leg, as he goes down early on his knees and drills it for four
short and turning into his pads. Clipped behind square

Looks like a great stop by Green, but the umpires will check. He was at deep point, and ran and dived to left to try and save it. And replays show he has pulled the ball back just in time, with both his elbow and leg clear of the rope. But, but... after a lot of replays, it is given four, much to the shock of Green. Anyway, the ball was short and wide of off, as Stoinis slapped that to deep backward point
good length on middle and off, turns away a bit. Punched back to the bowler
goes wide of the crease, and bowls full and wide of off. It turns away, as he misses his sweep. Wide given
starts with the googly. Good length on leg, and turns away to off stump. Tapped towards square leg
short ball, hinting to turn into middle. Punched to mid-off
just over cover! Full ball and tossed up on off, as Stoinis gets his front leg out of the way, and lofts that with an open face of the bat
wide outside leg. Full and pitching outside leg, as it turns down further with Stoinis missing his sweep
six down the pitch! Stoinis ensuring the powerplay ends in LSG's favour. This was full, and right in the slot on the stumps. He clears his front leg, and launches it with the full face of the bat
same ball, same result! This looked effortless. Short ball again, which angles down off stump. Stoinis sweeps this from there, and to the deep midwicket fielder's right
short and outside off. He fetches it from wide outside off after getting across, and swipes over short fine leg
full ball on off. Flicked to deep square leg
length ball shaping into off. Pushed to mid-off for a quick single
Jordan at mid-on slides to his left to save three runs. It was a full ball on the stumps, which Stoinis drove down between the stumps and the non-striker
length ball, shaping into middle and leg. Pushed to mid-off from deep in the crease
flicked away behind the wicket! Full ball, angling into his pads. He waits to play it late, before placing it to short fine leg's left
back of a length around off. Dabbed down

chance goes missing! Not a very easy one, even as Wadhera seemed to have misjudged it. He came in running from deep point, and even dived forward, only for the ball to slide through. The ball was full on off, as Stoinis lofted but got that off the outside edge, as the ball flew off
short and ending on fifth stump after angling across. Swatted to cover-point after leaping a little in the crease
short and wide of off. He has a stab, but gets an outside edge to deep third, as the ball angles away late
swatted between extra cover and cover-point! Shortish ball in the channel outside off, as he rides the bounce before slamming that away by getting on top of it
good length on fifth stump, as the ball shapes back in to end close to off. Stoinis pulled but missed. The ball perhaps didn't bounce as much as he would have liked

lofted to mid-on! Looked like he was done in by the skiddy nature of the ball. Jordan bowled a cross-seam ball on the shorter side of a length just outside off. The ball hinted to angle in, while also bouncing considerably. Mayers looked to pull, but got it off the higher side of the ball. Easy catch for Green on the edge of the circle
pushed aerially, and wide of long-off. Length ball on the stumps, and he just played forward without any foot movement
driven to long-off after making room. He backs away early, as the ball is on a length and the stumps
change of pace again. Length ball angling into middle and leg. Dabbed down to the bowler's right
good length on middle, and pulled to deep square. The fielder cuts it to his right

extra bounce! The ball takes off from a good length just outside off, as Kishan the keeper leaps and even gets a glove. Mayers had tried to slash but was beaten by the bounce, even as the ball dribbled away off Kishan's gloves
slower ball on a full length on middle. Tucked to cover
holds the pose! A one-bounce four over mid-off. Gets a full delivery - just ideal to drive - and lofts it down the pitch with the full face of the bat. Jordan runs back, but fails to grab it
quite full on off, and dragged to midwicket off the inside half of the bat

taken at deep third! Shokeen again the man, as he takes it low to his left. MI strike early, as Madhwal bowls on a length - the ball seemed to have straightened after being angled in - around fourth stump. Mankad had made room early to attack, and then heaved a big one. The ball flew off the outside half of the bat, and right to the fielder
back of a length outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket

direct hit would have got Mayers at the non-striker's end! But hang on, there is more drama yet. Ah, so he is eventually safe. This is what happened: it was a good length ball outside off, which Mankad punched to point. Shokeen at point dived to his right, and threw at the bowler's end and missed. David at mid-on threw again there, by which time the halfway-down Mayers was back
good length ball shaping into his pads. Clipped to short fine leg
good length ball, and wide of off. Angles away further, as Mankad slashes and misses
full ball angling across to end on off. Flicked to deep midwicket
much fuller ball on off. Pushed to point for a hurried single
ah, nicely guided between slip and backward point! Good length on fifth stump, as the ball straightens after pitching. Mayers pokes late at it, and finds the gap
just over the slip fielder! Even someone as tall as Green can't get a hand despite half a leap. Short and outside off, as Mayers has a flash but gets a top edge over the fielder
length ball on off, as Mayers dabs back without getting to the pitch of the ball
good length ball on fifth stump. Punched to point
